profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its website, the company describes Slack AI as a tool that boosts productivity by summarizing chats, searching files, taking meeting notes, translating conversations, and automating workflows. Slackbot functions as a personal AI agent within Slack that understands users and their workspaces, helping with meeting preparation, report analysis, and project brief creation. The company emphasizes that AI in Slack is integrated directly into where people already work rather than confined to separate browser tabs or standalone assistants, and that AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

Salesforce's AI products include Slack AI (embedded in messaging), Tableau AI (Einstein), which offers natural language queries and CRM data integration with Trust Layer governance, and Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, which provides CRM-embedded AI and agents. The company states that customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with LLMs hosted directly within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud to ensure data remains within Slack's trust boundary. Salesforce reports Agentforce agents can run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages to allow users to query data and trigger actions within the workflow.

As of January 31, 2026, Salesforce reported revenue of $41,525,000,000. The company is exposed to 220 lawsuits in California. Six Model Context Protocol servers enable integrations with Salesforce systems, including tools for SOQL queries, Salesforce administration, and DevOps pipeline management.
